# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest and Validation for J Anchor Days

**Filed:** 2026-08-24
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to compute the edge_capture and Sharpe for the current engine (or a baseline) on the J anchor days via Stage-1 backtest, then perform walk-forward OOS and real-fills validation on the top 3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) to assess robustness.

## Mechanism

Run Stage-1 backtest using the current engine configuration (as defined in automation/state/params.json) over the full history (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) to compute engine_pnl_on_J_winners and engine_loss_on_J_losers, then edge_capture = sum(winners) - sum(max(0, losers)). Compute aggregate Sharpe from the same backtest. Then perform walk-forward OOS: split data into expanding window, compute OOS Sharpe and edge_capture on held-out periods. Finally, validate real-fills on the top 3 J days using cached OPRA data to ensure simulation matches real fills within ±20%.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline.
2. **Sample bias:** We will use the full available history (2025-01-02..2026-06-18) for Stage-1; selection is all days; overfit risk mitigated by walk-forward OOS.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will perform walk-forward after Stage-1).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top 3 J days after Stage-1).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large loser on a J loser day; max drawdown from equity curve; blow-up scenario if engine takes large losers.
6. **Concentration:** Will compute after Stage-1; if top-5 days = X% of P&L, will state X.

## Pre-merge gate

Stage-1 backtest must complete, walk-forward OOS must show positive edge_capture and Sharpe >=0.70, real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <20% diff from simulated.
